integration_observation: The unrebased PR head cannot be compared end-to-end without an LLM key because its remember() API predates the current keyless/extractor path; the exact pure MMR selector is therefore replayed over the released baseline embeddings instead.
interpretation_rule: Treat MMR as improving this fixture only when the decisive source becomes eligible at top-5 and/or redundancy falls; do not generalize beyond these controlled corpora.
limits: Controlled synthetic corpora; not a general Cognee benchmark.
The released baseline is a live Cognee 1.6.0 CHUNKS run.
The MMR arm executes the exact mmr_select() implementation from PR #3707 over the baseline candidate order and embeddings; it is not an end-to-end run of the unmerged PR.
No live answer-generation judge is used.
